newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai copper ends little changed on flat LME.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai copper ends little changed on flat LME.

text.p: Shanghai copper futures ended little changed in slow trade on Tuesday due to an overnight consolidation on the London Metal Exchange, traders said.
The most active February 1997 contract ended at 19,250 yuan ($2,319) per tonne, unchanged from Monday's close. It opened at an intra-day high of 19,340 and hit a low of 19,240.
November ended unchanged at 18,980, December unchanged at 19,110, January fell 10 to 19,210, March rose 10 to 19,250, April 10 to 19,240 and May 20 to 19,220.
Combined volume fell to 15,550 tonnes from 31,670.
